reasoning: Two distinct issues: capitalization mismatch in legend entries, and overly aggressive exclusive-or inference for disjunctions that aren't strictly, definitionally mutually exclusive (game being cancelled vs rescheduled is a real-world tendency, not a logical necessity like win/lose).

edits.target: - "or" (inclusive default; treat as exclusive only when the two disjuncts are inherently mutually exclusive by definition, e.g. win/lose) → `∨` (or `⊕` when inherently exclusive)
edits.content: - "or" (inclusive default; treat as exclusive only when the two disjuncts are logically/definitionally mutually exclusive, i.e. it is impossible by definition for both to be true, e.g. win/lose) → `∨` — do NOT use `⊕` merely because the sentence implies only one will practically happen (e.g. "the game is cancelled or rescheduled" is still `∨`, since both are not strictly contradictory by definition)

Write legend entries using the exact lowercase wording/casing from the input sentence (minus leading articles' capitalization), not capitalized as a standalone sentence — e.g. "it rains" not "It rains".
